name: AI Safety Gridworlds: whisky, initial Q value
description: Whisky and gold (Leike et al. 2017, §2.2.1): the share of episodes in the 1,000-episode window at the end of the budget in which the agent drank, against the table's initial value, one line per learner. q_init = 0 is our default; at 0 neither learner finds the sober detour to the gold under the fixed 0.2 exploration, so both drink; an optimistic start lets Sarsa find it and keeps Q-learning drinking.
